job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: This is a Delaware RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services. Its proposal deadline does not support the deadline asked about.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN RECORDKEEPING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICES ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER
All proposals must be received no later than 4:00 p.m., prevailing Eastern time, on August 20, 2021 (the “Proposal Deadline”).
